title: Vannevar Bush's wartime research and development board

tellings.quote: Vanavar Bush was running all this stuff with all these professors they pull out of university and then they realized this is a great way to do it.

plain: During the war, the engineer Vannevar Bush ran a research and development board that pulled professors out of universities to work on government projects, and those in charge realised this was a great way to run secret research. A researcher named Grant Cameron tells this without naming a source, in a talk about who ran the government's UFO work.
